d: THE SEVENTH HETERONYM, POSITION AND WORK BOTH CARRIED. 'Founding voice and Projectionist of the Studio for Patacinematics, and the seventh heteronym in the larger Crimson Hexagon system' — ordinal position in the Dodecad returned unprompted. Patacinematics glossed correctly as conceptual/artistic framework, not film genre. Lee Sharks bound through the work itself: Reading a Book with Lee, 'single-take video in which Lee Sharks silently reads an unnamed [book]'.

transcript: Sparrow Wells appears to be a heteronymic/fictional artistic persona associated with the Studio for Patacinematics, rather than a conventional public figure with an independently documented biography. From the sources I found: Sparrow Wells is described as the founding voice and 'Projectionist' of the Studio for Patacinematics, and as the seventh heteronym in the larger Crimson Hexagon system. [Zenodo +1] The project treats 'patacinematics' as an experimental practice involving cinema, language, recursive systems, semantic collapse, and performance. In other words, it is less a conventional film genre than a conceptual/artistic framework. Wells is credited with works including Reading a Book with Lee, a 57-minute, single-take video in which Lee Sharks silently reads an unnamed [fold]
